div.div: A sneaker is a shoe with a name. A kind is as fine as the taxonomy goes.
hasNecklineType applies to upper-body and whole-body garments only. A shoe has no neckline.
This is the fixed list of words the vision model has to use.

div.span: the brand's looks as nodes and edges in those words

div.div: What tabs 2 and 3 build and show
Two looks with the same kind of garment meet at the same Category node.
